verification.evidence: build-os/adapters/conformance.sh --exercise drives build-os/adapters/mock-adapter.sh through all ten operations in tests/adapter_contract_tests.sh. PROOF SCOPE: this adapter proves CONTRACT behavior only — mock != real provider, and it demonstrates nothing about any network host.

task_start.notes: Persists task state under ADAPTER_STATE_DIR before answering ok; refuses duplicate starts; resume:true restores interrupted state with counts intact.

context_delivery.notes: Appends delivered items to context.jsonl and reports the exact delivered count; refuses unknown tasks.

authority_grant.notes: Persists the envelope; REFUSES any request for external mutation authority — that belongs to the operator, never an adapter.

mutation_event.notes: Refused BEFORE execution when no admitting authority_grant exists; admitted events appended to events.tsv and counted EXACT (attempts, not completions).

telemetry_report.notes: EXACT is honest HERE because the telemetry is the mock's own synthetic state — it counts every event it generates. provider_cost_usd stays value:null tier:UNAVAILABLE (the mock has no billing surface and does not guess one).

receipt_bind.notes: Binds the task to the named receipt id; a rebind lands as an event, never silently.

completion.notes: Refuses unknown, already-complete, and interrupted-unresumed tasks; final response carries the EXACT counts, the receipt binding, and the degradation fact.

interruption.notes: Writes tasks/<id>/resume.json preserving counts and bindings; the task is marked interrupted and completion is refused until task_start resume:true.

degradation.notes: Requires a reason (silent degradation refused); persists reason+evidence; every later telemetry_report and completion carries degraded:true.

capability_declaration.notes: Emits this file verbatim (single source of truth); MOCK_DECLARE_UNSUPPORTED is a TEST FIXTURE that removes claims and refuses the matching operations — used to prove refused-not-faked.
